name: MiMo V2.5 Free
short: Xiaomi's 310B/15B-active MiMo-V2.5 base (not Pro) omni-modal MoE served on a free Zen tier; Zen caps 200K/32K (native 1M), free period may use data to improve the model.
modalities: Text, image, audio, video in; text out
pricingNote: Free Zen tier; native from ~$0.14/$0.28 per 1M
freeTierNote: Free Zen tier for a limited time; data collected during the free period may be used to improve the model (not zero-retention)
standout: A full omni-modal MoE behind a $0 Zen meter — Xiaomi’s cheapest way to try flagship-shaped multimodal agents.
tradeoff: The free lane caps context hard and may train on your traffic; native capability only survives on paid hosting.
